components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Square ink action with a consistent northeast SVG arrow.
components.html: <button class="ds-primary" type="button">Sort now <svg class="ds-arrow" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 18 12-12M6 6h12v12"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-primary { font: 600 13px/1.55 var(--body, "DM Sans", sans-serif); color: var(--paper, #f4f5f0); background: var(--ink, #18231e); border: 0; border-bottom: 0; border-radius: 0; min-height: 44px; padding: 13px 20px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)), color 180ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)); outline-offset: 5px; }.ds-primary:not(:disabled):hover { background: #34523c; }.ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #395d40; } .ds-primary:not(:disabled):active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: .48; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary { transition: none; } }.ds-arrow { display: inline-block; width: 20px; height: 20px; margin-left: 26px; vertical-align: middle; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; } @media(max-width:760px){.ds-arrow{margin-left:12px;}}

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Transparent action with a single bottom rule.
components.css: .ds-secondary { font: 600 13px/1.55 var(--body, "DM Sans", sans-serif); color: var(--ink, #18231e); background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink, #18231e); border-radius: 0; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)), color 180ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)); outline-offset: 5px; }.ds-secondary:not(:disabled):hover { background: #e1e7db; }.ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #395d40; } .ds-secondary:not(:disabled):active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-secondary:disabled { opacity: .48; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-secondary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Text Action
components.description: Compact underlined action for service refresh and local utilities.
components.css: .ds-text { font: 600 12px/1.55 var(--body, "DM Sans", sans-serif); color: var(--ink, #18231e); background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 0; border-radius: 0; min-height: 32px; padding: 4px 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)), color 180ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)); outline-offset: 5px; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; }.ds-text:not(:disabled):hover { background: transparent; color: #395d40; }.ds-text:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #395d40; } .ds-text:not(:disabled):active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-text:disabled { opacity: .48; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-text { transition: none; } }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A quiet filled field with a bottom rule, visible label and helper text.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; color:var(--ink, #18231e); font:500 13px/1.55 var(--body, "DM Sans", sans-serif); } .ds-field input { width:100%; max-width:100%; min-height:45px; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid #788978; border-radius:0; background:#e9ede4; color:var(--ink, #18231e); padding:11px 12px; font:400 14px/1.55 var(--body, "DM Sans", sans-serif); caret-color:#3d6247; outline-offset:5px; } .ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #395d40;} .ds-field input:disabled{opacity:.48;cursor:not-allowed;} .ds-hint{color:var(--muted,#4c574f);font-size:12px;font-weight:400;}

components.name: Ruled Navigation
components.description: Four visible text links with an active underline; icons disappear on phones.
components.html: HomePreviewHistorySettings
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:32px;border-block:1px solid var(--ink, #18231e);font:400 13px/1.55 var(--body, "DM Sans", sans-serif);color:var(--ink, #18231e);} .ds-nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:50px;padding:0 1px;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;position:relative;outline-offset:5px;transition:color 180ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1));} .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"]::after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:-1px;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:var(--ink, #18231e);} .ds-nav a:hover{color:#395d40;} .ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #395d40;} .ds-nav svg{display:block;width:16px;height:16px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.3;} @media(max-width:760px){.ds-nav{justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:12px;}} @media(max-width:540px){.ds-nav svg{display:none;}.ds-nav a{min-height:46px;}} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav a{transition:none;}}

components.css: .ds-results{color:var(--ink, #18231e);font:400 12px/1.55 var(--body, "DM Sans", sans-serif);} .ds-metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:2px;margin:18px 0 12px;} .ds-metric{min-width:0;padding:16px 12px;background:var(--green,#abd4b7);} .ds-metric:first-child{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;padding:18px 20px;} .ds-metric:nth-child(2){background:var(--lavender,#d4b4ef);} .ds-metric:nth-child(4){background:var(--peach,#f2b58d);} .ds-metric:nth-child(5){background:var(--blue,#c2d7f3);} .ds-metric strong{display:block;font:400 36px/1.05 var(--display, "Bodoni Moda", Georgia, serif);font-variation-settings:"opsz" 18;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;} .ds-metric:first-child strong{font-size:56px;} .ds-metric span{display:block;margin-top:7px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;} .ds-metric:first-child span{font-size:13px;} .ds-caption{color:var(--muted,#4c574f);margin:0;} @media(max-width:760px){.ds-metrics{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));}.ds-metric{padding:14px;}} @media(max-width:540px){.ds-metrics{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));}.ds-metric{padding:13px 8px;}.ds-metric strong{font-size:32px;}}

components.name: Setting Switch
components.description: A labeled binary setting with an ink checked track and circular knob.
components.css: .ds-switch-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;padding:18px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#a5afa4);color:var(--ink, #18231e);font:600 14px/1.55 var(--body, "DM Sans", sans-serif);} .ds-switch{appearance:none;flex:0 0 auto;width:42px;height:24px;border:1px solid #657568;border-radius:20px;background:transparent;position:relative;cursor:pointer;margin:0;outline-offset:5px;} .ds-switch::after{content:"";position:absolute;width:16px;height:16px;left:3px;top:3px;border-radius:50%;background:#657568;transition:transform 180ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1));} .ds-switch:checked{background:var(--ink, #18231e);border-color:var(--ink, #18231e);} .ds-switch:checked::after{transform:translateX(18px);background:var(--paper, #f4f5f0);} .ds-switch:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #395d40;} .ds-switch:disabled{opacity:.48;cursor:not-allowed;} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-switch::after{transition:none;}}

components.name: Globe and File Artwork
components.description: The actual original inline SVG artwork, with a single reduced-motion-aware arrival.
components.html: a place for every file
components.css: .ds-art{width:100%;max-width:430px;color:var(--ink, #18231e);} .ds-order-art{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;overflow:visible;} .ds-art-note{display:block;text-align:right;font:400 18px/1.55 var(--display, "Bodoni Moda", Georgia, serif);transform:rotate(-5deg);padding-right:26px;margin-top:-12px;} .ds-art-note::after{content:"";display:block;width:122px;height:8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink, #18231e);border-radius:50%;margin-left:auto;transform:rotate(-5deg);} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-art{animation:ds-art-arrive 650ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)) both;} @keyframes ds-art-arrive{from{transform:translateY(10px);clip-path:inset(0 0 12% 0);}to{transform:translateY(0);clip-path:inset(0 0 -10% 0);}}} @media(max-width:540px){.ds-art{max-width:216px;}.ds-art-note{font-size:13px;margin-top:-22px;padding-right:5px;}.ds-art-note::after{width:90px;}}

narrative.overview:
Sortify combines cool paper, near-black green ink and high-contrast serif headings with compact, readable controls. A fading color field and authored globe/file line art give the utility an identity; open sections and fine rules keep operational information clear. This records the implemented local candidate, not an Android-verified release.

The user pinned the BOLT/Twinkle references and replaced the earlier dashboard direction with one light theme. No concept roll, seed or app comp was generated or approved. The implementation is the token source; `PRODUCT.md` supplies product truth and `docs/design-direction.md` records the confirmed visual authority.
keyCharacteristics: One light paper-and-ink theme, independent of operating-system appearance.
Bodoni Moda headings and counts; DM Sans navigation, labels and controls.
Open sections, thin dividers and square functional surfaces.
Fading gradients and original inline line artwork.
Flat result colors, explicit states and restrained motion.

rules.name: The Single Light Theme Rule
rules.body: Keep the paper-and-ink system under both operating-system appearance preferences. Do not add an automatic dark variant.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use the serif for headings, section legends, artwork annotation and counts. Use DM Sans for actions, navigation and explanations.

rules.name: The Open Section Rule
rules.body: Separate routine content with space and rules. Do not reintroduce rounded or outlined dashboard cards around the operating sections.

dos: **Do** preserve the single light theme and locally bundled font pairing.
**Do** align open sections to the shell and separate them with space and fine rules.
**Do** keep outcome labels, helper text, long paths and keyboard focus visible.
**Do** use the established SVG action arrow consistently when an action needs an icon.
**Do** keep Save/Discard in normal flow and keep artwork clear of headings at narrow widths.
**Do** respect reduced motion and label simulated data explicitly.
donts: **Don't** add rounded cards, enclosing dashboard panels or boxed fieldsets.
**Don't** add automatic dark-mode switching or a theme selector.
**Don't** replace the original line artwork with generic decorative icons or unrelated stock imagery.
**Don't** use shadows to separate ordinary sections or animate the artwork continuously.
**Don't** invent file statistics or imply that browser demonstration proves Android-manager support.
